assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single production game UI blank deployment shield badge, transparent PNG, square canvas.
Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its broad hand-painted carved planes, believable thickness and soft highlights. Do NOT reproduce the large card.
Create ONE small shield-shaped metal mounting plate, front facing orthographic, symmetrical, nearly square proportions width:height 0.90. It will render at only 64 by 70 screen pixels on the upper-left stone corner of a hero card. Broad shallow top shoulders, straight-ish side walls, single short downward point, simple strong silhouette. A restrained thick warm aged bronze bevel around a deeply recessed muted dark petrol-teal center, with a tight dark contact shadow and a substantial darker bottom edge. Center must be perfectly blank and calm, usable for a native ivory crossed-swords icon. The blank center takes about 68% of the width. Warm soft light from upper-left, broad simple low-frequency painted surfaces like polished Hearthstone game interface props, quiet matte and slightly worn material, no greasy specular highlight, no noise overlay. Keep metal frame narrow enough to support the icon instead of competing with it.
Composition: one isolated centered shield occupying 90% of canvas height, genuine alpha transparency outside shield and tight shadow. Not an entire card, not a mockup, not a scene, no additional objects.
No text, no lettering, no symbol, no swords, no jewels, no crown, no spikes, no rivets, no wings, no ornament, no glow, no glitter, no white background, no checkerboard painted into the image.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production game UI blank rank medallion on genuinely transparent background.
Input image: style reference only for broad hand-painted planes and believable matte thickness; do not copy its rectangular card composition.
Make ONE round bronze rank mounting badge. Perfectly front-facing, round circular silhouette with a broad simple chamfered antique warm-bronze rim, very slightly faceted outer edge, a deeply recessed dark charcoal-brown blank center. No ornament, no numbers, no letters. This will render at only 64x64 pixels in a hero-card upper corner and must have an immediately readable clean outline. Blank circular dark center 68% diameter for a large ivory Roman numeral drawn by the game engine. Restrained soft upper-left illumination, broad bevel highlight and darker lower-right thickness, tight contact shadow. Hand-painted Hearthstone-like game prop, substantial simple sculpted planes, muted matte bronze, no wet polish or bright glitter. Keep most surface area calm. Badge fills 90% of square canvas.
Exactly one isolated round medallion, actual alpha transparency outside it, nothing else. No card, no shield, no gems, no stars, no wings, no crown, no flourishes, no scratches/noise overlay, no tiny details, no glow, no text, no checkerboard background.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single blank skill icon socket, production transparent PNG for a Godot hero detail panel.
Input image: visual reference for the two skill-icon mounts immediately left of the active and passive skill text. Generate only ONE empty socket matching their shape and material, no screenshot and no other UI.
A rounded-square inset icon frame, front facing orthographic, softly squared body with broadly rounded clipped corners, substantial grey-brown stone or dark aged metal body, narrow warm bronze worn bevel along the inward opening, very dark calm recessed center. Broad smooth hand-painted surfaces, soft upper-left light, a little warm edge highlight, dark lower-right side thickness. Designed to render at 84x84 pixels. The central opening occupies at least 72% of total width, completely blank, no emblem or letter, no plus symbol. Center opaque dark brown-black; genuine alpha transparent outside the silhouette. About 90% of square canvas filled by one frame. Preserve the understated matte material in the reference. No glossy enamel, no gems, no gold ornament, no glow, no gritty noise, no spikes, no screen layout or card, no text.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single blank long horizontal equipment tray, transparent PNG, production 2D game UI.
Input image is visual reference: reproduce ONLY the long horizontal inset stone equipment shelf at the very bottom of the RIGHT details panel, underneath the attributes. No text or equipment icons, just its blank frame and center. This is a dedicated wide shallow tray, not a shrunk large window.
Silhouette ratio 6.8 to 1, straight wide horizontal shape with clipped softly rounded ends. Thick dark grey-brown stone upper and lower lips, smooth wide bevels, narrow muted warm edge lights from upper-left; dark recessed calm matte brown inner field. The border should be only about 7% of tray height. Big readable planar forms, no detailed cracks, no ornaments, no bright gold, no oily shine, no fine noise. Give it convincing carved shallow depth and tight contact shadow. Interior is blank, all one continuous material. It will render approximately 690x104px. Asset fills most of canvas width with small clear transparent outside margin. Genuine alpha transparency outside this one isolated tray. No text, no letters, no labels, no equipment, no icons, no other objects, no surrounding UI screenshot.
